```python
import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the dataset
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert 'date' column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Aggregate total sales per day
daily_sales = coffee_sales.groupby('date')['total'].sum().reset_index()

# Set the figure size
plt.figure(figsize=(14, 6))

# Plot the data
sns.lineplot(data=daily_sales, x='date', y='total', marker='o', color='b')

# Add a title and labels
plt.title('Total Sales per Day', fontsize=16)
plt.xlabel('Date', fontsize=12)
plt.ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=12)

# Rotate date labels
plt.xticks(rotation=45)

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
```
